TCG 13D amendment filed Dec 29, 2023 disclosing going-private interest; Company 8-K Jan 2, 2024 confirming Special Committee formation
Stock rose above $1.55 offer price as Merger Agreement finalization neared; Merger Agreement executed Feb 25, 2024

leaked_early.details: TCG filed a 13D amendment on Dec 29, 2023, and the company filed an 8-K on Jan 2, 2024, both less than 2 months before the Feb 26, 2024 announcement. No evidence of a press report/rumor >= ~1 month prior.

notes: The deal was a take-private by the largest stockholder (TCG, ~26%) after a failed NASH program and severe cash burn; the Special Committee rejected $1.45, countered above $2.00, but settled at $1.55 after four external parties declined interest.
